content.short: Hivemapper is a decentralized mapping network on Solana where users earn HONEY tokens for collecting 4K dashcam imagery.
content.description:
Hivemapper is a decentralized mapping network (DePIN) built on the Solana blockchain that rewards contributors for collecting high-quality street-level imagery. By using specialized 4K dashcams, drivers around the world can map their surroundings and earn HONEY tokens in exchange for their data. This community-driven approach creates a fresher, more accurate, and more accessible map than traditional centralized services.

The platform leverages blockchain technology to ensure that all mapping data is verified and transparently rewarded. Hivemapper’s decentralized model reduces the costs of map maintenance while empowering individuals to participate in the creation of a global resource. It provides a scalable and sustainable solution for the mapping industry, fostering a new era of collaborative geospatial data.
